method: Assistant primary coding from public action, observation and terminal metadata fields, supported by deterministic extraction; no independent human adjudication assumed.
locators: Zero-based JSON array indices in the exact SHA256-identified raw .traj files.

counting_rules.edit_attempt: An observed edit/create command; unsuccessful argument or lint validation still counts as an attempt.
counting_rules.confirmed_edit: Positive tool File updated receipt with a file header. Null when no model-attributed modification can be confirmed.
counting_rules.verification_attempt: An executed test-suite, custom reproduction, or build/render command with a recorded observation; static inspection alone is excluded.
counting_rules.explicit_finish: An exact submit command in matching trajectory and history action fields. Cost-limit exit/autosubmit is excluded.
counting_rules.stop_class: agent_acknowledged requires submit plus matching terminal submitted status; controller_boundary uses recorded exit_cost; both is reserved for coexisting explicit request and controller boundary.
